body_markdown:
Convenient Public Storage options in Los Angeles include 300 Avery St in the Arts District, 2500 W 6th St in Westlake, 1712 Glendale Blvd near Echo Park and 3636 Beverly Blvd near Historic Filipinotown. These locations connect with major routes and corridors such as U.S. 101, I-5, State Route 2 and Wilshire Boulevard.


The most convenient choice depends on your neighborhood, traffic pattern and how you plan to move your belongings. Compare access hours, loading arrangements, unit sizes and features before reserving.


## What Public Storage Options Are Available in Los Angeles?


Public Storage has 168 facilities in Los Angeles and nearby communities. Climate-controlled storage is available at 53 facilities, while 89 offer car storage. Available spaces range from lockers to 10×30 units.


Common unit sizes are widely available throughout the area:

Monthly prices start at $16, and the average monthly unit price is $152. Prices, promotions, features and availability vary by location and can change.


## Convenient Self-Storage in Los Angeles: 300 Avery St


Public Storage at[300 Avery St](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-ca-los-angeles/2223.html) is in Downtown Los Angeles’s Arts District near Little Tokyo and the U.S. 101 freeway.


The facility offers indoor storage in small, medium and large sizes. Access is currently available from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. Monday through Friday and from 6 a.m. to 5 p.m. Saturday and Sunday.


**Why it’s convenient:** The Avery Street location provides an in-city option for customers in the Arts District, Little Tokyo and nearby downtown neighborhoods. It may also fit customers who regularly travel on U.S. 101 or streets leading into Downtown Los Angeles.


## Where Else Can You Find Convenient Self-Storage in Los Angeles?


Los Angeles traffic can turn a short distance into a long trip. A facility on the same side of the city as your home, workplace or regular errands may be the easier choice.


### Westlake Near MacArthur Park


Public Storage at[2500 W 6th St](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-ca-los-angeles/2217.html) is in Westlake near MacArthur Park, with access from Wilshire Boulevard, Beverly Boulevard and U.S. 101.


The facility offers indoor storage in small, medium and large sizes. Access is currently available from 9:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. Monday through Friday and from 9:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. Saturday and Sunday.


**Why it’s convenient:** This location may suit customers in Westlake, Koreatown and nearby central Los Angeles neighborhoods who want an indoor option near familiar east-west streets.


### Glendale Boulevard Near Echo Park


Public Storage at[1712 Glendale Blvd](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-ca-los-angeles/17.html) is near Echo Park and Silver Lake, with connections to Sunset Boulevard, State Route 2 and I-5.


The facility offers car storage and small, medium and large units, with indoor and outdoor options. Access is currently available from 9:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. Monday through Friday and from 9:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. Saturday and Sunday.


**Why it’s convenient:** The Glendale Boulevard location can work well for customers in Echo Park, Silver Lake and nearby northeast Los Angeles neighborhoods or those who regularly travel on Sunset Boulevard or I-5.


### Beverly Boulevard Near Historic Filipinotown


Public Storage at[3636 Beverly Blvd](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-ca-los-angeles/87.html) is near Historic Filipinotown, Koreatown and the U.S. 101 freeway.


**Why it’s convenient:** This location may fit customers in Historic Filipinotown, Koreatown and nearby central neighborhoods or those whose regular route includes Beverly Boulevard or U.S. 101.


## What Makes a Self-Storage Facility Convenient in Los Angeles?


In Los Angeles, convenience often depends on choosing the right neighborhood and avoiding an unnecessary freeway trip.


When comparing Los Angeles storage facilities, consider:


- **Your side of the city:** A location near downtown, Westlake, Echo Park or Historic Filipinotown can reduce time spent crossing Los Angeles.
- **Your usual route:** Look near U.S. 101, I-10, I-5, State Route 2 or another road you already use.
- **Access hours:** The featured locations have different opening times, so compare their schedules with when you expect to visit.
- **Loading and parking:** Review where you can park or unload and the route from the entrance to the unit.
- [Climate-controlled storage in Los Angeles](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-ca-los-angeles/climate-controlled-storage-units) **:** Los Angeles heat and seasonal temperature changes can affect belongings that react to changing conditions. These units are designed to help maintain more consistent temperature and humidity levels than non-climate-controlled storage.
- **Indoor or outdoor access:** Indoor units may involve hallway or elevator access. Some outdoor units offer Drive-Up Access, but confirm the feature for the exact unit.
- [Vehicle storage in Los Angeles](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-ca-los-angeles/car-storage-units) **:** Car, boat, RV and motorcycle storage is available at select Los Angeles-area facilities.


## Which Storage Unit Size Should You Choose?


Choose a unit based on what you plan to store and how much room you need to reach it.


- A **5×5 unit** can help clear an apartment closet or hold boxes and smaller household items.
- A **5×10 unit** can accommodate the contents of one room, including some furniture.
- A **10×10 unit** offers space for furnishings and boxes from several rooms.
- A **10×20 unit** can support a larger move or home project involving multiple rooms.


Actual dimensions and capacities vary. Use the[Public Storage Size Guide](https://www.publicstorage.com/size-guide) and review the specific unit before renting when possible.


## How Do You Choose the Most Convenient Storage Facility in Los Angeles?


Start with the neighborhood and driving route already in your routine. Avery Street may suit customers in the Arts District and Downtown Los Angeles, while West 6th Street provides a Westlake option. Glendale Boulevard can fit an Echo Park or Silver Lake routine, and Beverly Boulevard may be easier for customers near Historic Filipinotown or Koreatown.


Then compare access hours, loading arrangements, unit type and size. If you need climate-controlled storage, Drive-Up Access or vehicle storage, confirm availability for the exact facility and unit before reserving.
